prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Flow reorderings, targeted guidance hints (photo lighting/quality, path decision helper, restore assurance), streamlined layouts (single-click identity, card carousel), hotkey shortcut copy, key desktop flows (summon, visibility/control), and interactive waiting status updates consistently produce significant wins.
Harmful changes: Major flow overhauls (docking setup, split layout), intrusive split view or spotlight layouts, interactive practice flows, and cheat sheet screens consistently lead to performance drops or early test terminations.
No effect seen: Dedicated tutorial or environment prep screens, static waiting hints and carousels, incentive badges, and background completion notifications repeatedly show no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large positive predictions (+8.0% or higher) consistently overstate actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or severe negative results.
Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially hotkey shortcut copy, account security/restore hints, and interactive waiting status updates—frequently exceed low or negative initial predictions.

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Placement Readiness Check Flow: Introduce a visual desktop render and overlay status check during the waiting phase. (why: Support emails show 3 cases where pets failed to display on the desktop or the app stalled on launch.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Desktop Visibility Quick Setup Screen: Add a dedicated quick controls guidance screen right after home intro explaining tray icon and hotkey shortcuts. (why: Multiple support emails (3) report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to show, hide, or talk to the pet.)
2: [home, wait_info] Custom Pet Generation Visual Progress Status: Display real-time dynamic stage indicators and estimated time on the waiting screen during pet creation. (why: Home waiting stage has a median time of 201s and high drop-off; clearer status feedback keeps users engaged while waiting.)
3: [adoption, copy] Clear Photo Subject Guidance Headline Copy: Update the photo upload screen copy to explicitly request well-lit, single-subject photos. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly due to photo inputs.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Centered Quick Auth Choice Layout: Switch the sign-in screen to a centered layout focusing on single-click identity options. (why: Sign-in mean duration is 567s; a clean centered layout reduces visual clutter and speeds up sign-in.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Opt-In: Enable optional system notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation completes. (why: Mean home wait time is 2336s, indicating users minimize or leave the window while waiting for generation.)

scores.note: Key desktop readiness flow aligns with past wins for desktop controls.
Dedicated tutorial screens consistently show no effect or drop conversion.
Interactive waiting status updates reliably reduce drop-off during long waits.
Targets largest funnel drop-off step using proven photo quality guidance hints.
Streamlined single-click identity layouts historically produce strong wins.
Background completion notifications consistently show no clear effect.
